channel.title: XKSH808 - Notes from the Shop
channel.description: Plain talk about getting found online, from Honolulu. Short posts, no jargon.

item.title: It Forgets, On Purpose
item.description: Everything I need to remember goes in my notes app. Phone numbers. A half idea. What somebody told me at the counter. It just sits there. It doesn't lift a finger on its own. And that's fine — it's a notebook.

item.title: Your Listing Says You Sell Something Else
item.description: Somebody wants what you sell. They type it in. You don't come up. Not because you're missing. You're on the map. You've got reviews. Your pin's in the right spot.

item.title: Your Website Says Not Secure. Right Next to Your Name.
item.description: Somebody looks you up. Your name comes up. And right there in the address bar, in front of your shop's name, it says: Not Secure. They don't know what that means. They just know it sounds bad. So they back out and call the next place.

item.title: Your Phone Dings at 2 AM. Here's How to Stop It.
item.description: Your phone goes off at 2 in the morning. A ding. A buzz on the nightstand. You're awake now. It's almost never anything. A store you bought from once. A news alert. Somebody's group text.

item.title: Nobody Takes a Two-Hour-a-Week Job
item.description: There's a job in your shop that takes about two hours a week. You can't hire for it. Nobody wants two hours a week. And by the time you'd explain it, train them, check the work — you've spent the two hours anyway.

item.title: The Map Sends Them to the Wrong Block
item.description: Somebody's looking for you. They pull up the map and hit directions. It takes them two blocks over. A parking lot. Somebody's driveway. They look around. No shop. They give up and go somewhere else. You never hear about it. Nobody calls to say your pin's in the wrong place. They just don't come.

item.title: You Changed Your Number. Your Website Didn't.
item.description: Somebody's phone breaks. Water, drop, whatever. So you get a new number. You tell your friends. You tell your regulars. You tell the guy who does your insurance. You forget the website. That number on your contact page? Still the old one. Somebody else has it now. Maybe a stranger. Maybe nobody.

item.title: Your Phone Isn't Broken. It's Full of Photos.
item.description: Your phone says "Storage Almost Full." It's not broken. It's just full. And it's almost always photos. Here's the thing nobody tells you. You don't have to delete them. Deleting is the scary part, so people freeze and do nothing.

item.title: The Back Office Fits in Your Pocket Now
item.description: Nobody opens a shop because they love paperwork. You open it to make the thing. Poke. Cuts. Coffee. Whatever's on your sign. Then the day fills up with the other stuff. The invoice. The reminder. The follow-up. The post you meant to write.

item.title: The Review You Never Answered Is Still Talking
item.description: Somebody leaves you a review. Three stars. "Food was great. Waited a while." You read it. You feel it. You close the app. That review is still there. And now it's not just talking to you. It's talking to everybody deciding whether to walk in.

item.title: Somebody Tried to Hire You. The Message Went Nowhere.
item.description: A guy fills out the form on your website. Phone. Thumb. Hits send. He sees "Thanks! We'll be in touch." Then he waits. Nobody calls. So he moves on to the next shop. You never saw it. The form has been quietly broken for months.

item.title: If It Rushes You, It's Not Your Bank
item.description: Somebody reads you a text. "Your account is locked. Tap here to verify." Is it real? Here's the test I hand out. It works almost every time. Read it out loud. Slowly. If it sounds like it's rushing you, it's not your bank.

item.title: You're Not on the List
item.description: Watch somebody look for lunch. Phone out. Two words. "Poke near me." Three names come up. Maybe four. That's the whole list. You're not on it. Nothing wrong with your food. Nothing wrong with your door. You just never claimed the little map card with your name on it. Hours nobody updated. No photos.
